source_SHA_rule: stage1 saved lineage; each real TU freshly hash-checked exactly before its single native compile; not a full423 rehash
ASM_note: CPU/interwork explicit same AC5 diagnostic selection; all other false actual Aads flags omitted; literal includes only. Query exact same-bin assembler --vsn once only if ASM reached.
warning_policy: Compiler default warnings; original --diag_error=warning once, no suppression based on XML wLevel
optimization_policy: uniform -O1 -Otime, deliberate override; original values in immutable raw and each chain
RTE_policy: Only literal input paths/macros and true compiler builtins; no IDE-implied _RTE_ macro, generated new-target include or new RTE headers. Existing old empty RTE header may be found only through explicit include paths.
defaults_policy: Use this installed AC5 compiler's default endianness, enum container and wchar type without invented switches. No forced enum_is_int, wchar32, GNU mode or microlib. These are deliberately selected defaults of this diagnostic recipe, not an assertion that defaults match the legacy binary.
first_object_attribute_gate: After the first genuine TU produces an object, inspect saved ELF/build attributes with the already trusted fromelf --text -v. Record actual CPU/LE/SP/VFPargs/enum/wchar/denormal or UNKNOWN if not emitted. Compare with actual target intent and already saved library evidence. Unexpected/incompatible/unresolved ABI stops before next TU/link; do not silently recompile the first object with changed options.
